articles.title: Divorce, smartphones and control - BBC sees how Taliban run Afghanistan
articles.description: Five years after the Taliban’s return, the BBC follows senior figures as the group reshapes the country.
articles.titleJa: 離婚、スマートフォン、そして統制 – BBCがタリバンによるアフガニスタン統治の実態を報じる
articles.summary: タリバンがアフガニスタンを統治する様子をBBCが取材。離婚やスマホ使用への統制、国家再編の現状を探る。

articles.title: Nearly 90,000 told to evacuate as wildfire approaches Reno, Nevada
articles.description: The fire has burned around 10,500 acres and is completely uncontained, officials say.
articles.titleJa: ネバダ州リノに山火事が迫り、約9万人に避難指示
articles.summary: ネバダ州リノ近郊で発生した山火事が約1万500エーカーを焼失し、鎮火せず拡大。約9万人に避難指示が出された。

articles.title: Trump says Canada wants 'benefits' of being US state after trade talks collapse
articles.description: Canada's PM said he was "reluctantly" announcing retaliatory tariffs and accused the US of starting a trade war.
articles.titleJa: トランプ氏、貿易交渉決裂後カナダは米国の『恩恵』を望むと発言
articles.summary: 米加貿易交渉が決裂し、カナダ首相は報復関税を発表。トランプ氏はカナダが米国の『恩恵』を望んでいると批判、貿易戦争の様相。

articles.title: Nearly three million Teslas recalled in China over hidden door handles
articles.description: Other brands affected by the recall include Chinese carmakers XPeng, Xiaomi and Geely.
articles.titleJa: 中国でテスラ約300万台が隠れたドアハンドルの問題でリコール
articles.summary: 中国でテスラ車約300万台がドアハンドル問題でリコールされた。XPeng、Xiaomi、Geelyなど中国メーカーも影響を受ける。

articles.title: King of Norway's health has worsened, palace says
articles.description: Norway's King Harald remains in hospital receiving antibiotics for a bloodstream bacterial infection.
articles.titleJa: ノルウェー国王の容体が悪化、王室が発表
articles.summary: ノルウェー国王ハーラル5世の容体が悪化し、王室が発表。現在も入院中で、血液感染症治療を受けている。

articles.title: China probes use of formaldehyde to keep cabbages fresh
articles.description: Using the carcinogen to preserve food is prohibited in China, the world's largest producer of cabbages.
articles.titleJa: 中国、キャベツ鮮度保持のためのホルムアルデヒド使用を調査
articles.summary: 中国でキャベツの鮮度保持に発がん性物質ホルムアルデヒドが使用されていないか調査中。中国では食品への使用は禁止されている。

articles.title: Ex-cricket captains urge 'proper medical care' for Imran Khan
articles.description: The former skippers say it is "basic decency" for Pakistan to comply with a court-ordered medical assessment.
articles.titleJa: 元クリケット主将らがイムラン・カーン氏への『適切な医療』を要求
articles.summary: 元クリケット主将らが、イムラン・カーン元首相に対する裁判所命令の医療評価実施を「基本的な礼儀」としてパキスタン政府に要求。

articles.title: Maradona's 'Hand of God' ball sells for £2.5m
articles.description: The football with which Diego Maradona scored his famous 'hand of God' goal in the 1986 World Cup quarter-final victory over England is sold at auction.
articles.titleJa: マラドーナの『神の手』ボールが250万ポンドで落札
articles.summary: 1986年W杯でディエゴ・マラドーナ選手が「神の手」ゴールを決めたサッカーボールがオークションで250万ポンド（約4億円）で落札。

articles.title: Four arrested over boxing champion's murder in South Africa
articles.description: One of the suspects is due in court on Monday to be charged with murder and attempted murder.
articles.titleJa: 南アフリカでボクシング王者の殺人容疑で4人逮捕
articles.summary: 南アフリカでボクシング王者の殺害容疑で4人が逮捕された。容疑者のうち1人は月曜日に殺人および殺人未遂の罪で起訴される。

articles.title: Australian shark attack victim grateful for 'second chance at life'
articles.description: Leah Stewart was mauled by a shark in June, suffering multiple bites to her arms and legs.
articles.titleJa: オーストラリアのサメ襲撃被害者、『第二の人生』に感謝
articles.summary: 6月にサメに襲われ重傷を負ったリア・スチュワートさんが、「第二の人生」を得られたことに感謝の意を表明した。

articles.title: Dutch pull out of 'no longer neutral' Eurovision
articles.description: The Netherlands will not participate in the 2027 Eurovision Song Contest in Bulgaria, the state broadcaster has said, citing divisions over the situation in Gaza. It's the second time the country is boycotting the event.
articles.titleJa: オランダ、「もはや中立ではない」ユーロビジョンから撤退
articles.summary: オランダの国営放送は、ガザ情勢を巡る対立を理由に、2027年のユーロビジョン・ソング・コンテストへの不参加を表明。同国がこのイベントをボイコットするのは2度目となる。

articles.title: Scientists discover new 'immune hubs' in skull bone marrow
articles.description: In mouse skull marrow, 'immune hubs' that actively defend the brain have been discovered. Similar cells exist in human skulls, but their role remains unclear.
articles.titleJa: 科学者、頭蓋骨骨髄に新たな「免疫ハブ」を発見
articles.summary: マウスの頭蓋骨骨髄に脳を積極的に防御する「免疫ハブ」が発見された。人間の頭蓋骨にも同様の細胞が存在するが、その役割は未だ不明である。

articles.title: Spiraling health costs force Iranians to delay care
articles.description: A single chemotherapy session in Iran can cost six times the monthly minimum wage. As drug prices soar and medicine is in short supply, doctors say more patients are delaying or abandoning treatment.
articles.titleJa: 医療費高騰がイラン人に受診延期を強いる
articles.summary: イランでは1回の化学療法に月間最低賃金の6倍かかる。薬剤価格高騰と医薬品不足のため、治療を遅らせたり諦めたりする患者が増加している。

articles.title: India news: Police used 'excessive force' on CJP protesters
articles.description: Amnesty International alleges that police in the capital New Delhi and the state of Bihar used excessive force against youth-led Cockroach protesters. Full details and more in DW's roundup of major headlines in India.
articles.titleJa: インド：警察がCJP抗議者に「過剰な武力」を行使と報告
articles.summary: アムネスティ・インターナショナルは、インドのデリーとビハール州の警察が、若者主導の「ゴキブリ」抗議者に対し過剰な武力を行使したと主張している。

articles.title: Germany news: State premier visits VW for crisis talks
articles.description: Political leaders are visiting car giant Volkswagen for crisis talks, while Chancellor Friedrich Merz meets party colleagues after a testing summer. DW has more.
articles.titleJa: ドイツ：州首相がVWを訪問し危機協議
articles.summary: ドイツの政治指導者らが自動車大手フォルクスワーゲンを訪問し、危機協議を行う。一方、メルツ首相は厳しい夏の後、党幹部と会談する。

articles.title: Ukraine news: UK PM Burnham arrives in Kyiv to show support
articles.description: Andy Burnham's first trip abroad as PM will see him co-chair a meeting of the Coalition of the Willing and meet with Volodymyr Zelenskyy. The visit comes as Ukraine marks its 35th independence day. DW has more.
articles.titleJa: ウクライナ：英国バーナム首相、支援表明のためキーウに到着
articles.summary: アンディ・バーナム英国首相が初の外遊でキーウに到着。有志連合の会合を共同議長し、ゼレンスキー大統領と会談。ウクライナ独立35周年と重なる訪問。

articles.title: New Zealand proposes social media ban for under-16s
articles.description: The government is set to follow Australia's lead and introduce a bill banning children from social media. But the plan already faces opposition from within the ruling coalition.
articles.titleJa: ニュージーランド、16歳未満のソーシャルメディア利用禁止を提案
articles.summary: ニュージーランド政府は、オーストラリアに続き16歳未満の子供のソーシャルメディア利用を禁止する法案を導入予定。しかし、与党連合内ですでに反対意見が出ている。

articles.title: US: Wildfire forces mass evacuations near Reno, Nevada
articles.description: A wind-driven wildfire has forced roughly 42,000 people to evacuate and destroyed homes as fire crews continue to battle extreme conditions.
articles.titleJa: 米国：ネバダ州リノ近郊で山火事、大規模避難を強制
articles.summary: ネバダ州リノ近郊で発生した風力で広がる山火事により、約42,000人が避難を強いられ、複数の家屋が破壊された。消防隊は厳しい状況下で消火活動を続けている。

articles.title: Norway: King Harald's health has 'deteriorated,' palace says
articles.description: The 89-year-old King of Norway is Europe's oldest reigning monarch. He has been suffering from a blood condition.
articles.titleJa: ノルウェー：ハラルド国王の健康状態が「悪化」と王宮が発表
articles.summary: ノルウェー王室は、89歳のハラルド国王の健康状態が「悪化」したと発表した。国王はヨーロッパ最年長の君主で、血液疾患を患っている。

articles.title: Kazakhstan parliamentary vote cements president's power
articles.description: Candidates from seven state-approved parties took part in the election, while opposition parties were banned. As Central Asia's largest nation, Kazakhstan maintains a delicate balance between Russia and the West.
articles.titleJa: カザフスタン議会選挙、大統領の権力強化を確実化
articles.summary: カザフスタンでの議会選挙は、7つの国公認政党の候補者が参加し、野党は禁止された。この結果により、中央アジア最大国であるカザフスタンの大統領の権力が強化された。

articles.title: Landslide at waste mound in Guinea capital kills 30, government says
articles.description:
Dump site in Conakry, which minister had just promised to move, collapsed after heavy rain in west African state
A ⁠landslide at a huge waste dump in Guinea’s capital has killed 30 people, the government said on Sunday, after heavy rains overnight prompted it to ⁠collapse, engulfing nearby tents and shacks.
The incident occurred less than a week after the government announced plans to close the ⁠site and relocate the waste because of the threat it posed, especially during the rainy season, which causes landslides and fatal flash ⁠floods each year in crowded, underdeveloped cities across parts of West Africa.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ギニア首都の廃棄物集積場で地滑り、30人死亡と政府発表
articles.summary: ギニア首都コナクリの巨大廃棄物集積場で地滑りが発生し、豪雨で崩壊。近くのテントや小屋を巻き込み、30人が死亡した。政府は以前からこの場所の閉鎖と移転を計画していた。

articles.title: US deports 20 people to Liberia, the first of 1,200 migrants under Trump deal
articles.description:
Agreement is among largest third-country deportations driven by Trump administration’s immigration crackdown 
Twenty deportees from the United States arrived in Liberia on Thursday, as part of a new agreement that will see the west African country receive as many as 1,200 people under the Trump administration’s immigration crackdown.
The group arrived at the Roberts international airport outside the capital, Monrovia. The Liberia-US agreement is one of the largest third-country deportation arrangements pursued by the administration since Trump returned to office last year.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 米国、トランプ政権の合意に基づき移民1,200人のうち最初の20人をリベリアに送還
articles.summary: 米国は、トランプ政権の移民規制策に基づく新たな合意により、最初の20人をリベリアに送還。リベリアは最大1,200人の送還者を受け入れる予定。

articles.title: More than 100 dead after goldmine collapses in Central African Republic
articles.description:
The collapse was caused by a landslide, while local officials say the death toll is likely to rise as recovery efforts continue
More than 100 people have died after an artisanal goldmine at a small village in western Central African Republic (CAR) caved in due to a landslide, local officials and aid workers said on Wednesday.
The landslide happened on Tuesday afternoon in the village of Zamboye, about 50km (31 miles) from the town of Baboua and close to the border of Cameroon. Footage on social media appeared to show an avalanche of sand descend on a group of people, likely the miners, and cover them.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 中央アフリカ共和国で金鉱が崩壊、100人以上死亡
articles.summary: 中央アフリカ共和国西部の手掘り金鉱が地滑りにより崩壊し、100人以上が死亡。現地当局は死者数が増える可能性を指摘。

articles.title: Five Americans among seven killed in safari helicopter crash in Kenya
articles.description:
Officials say all seven people onboard killed, including Telemundo executive and Ecuador intelligence chief
Seven people, including five Americans, were killed when a safari helicopter crashed on Wednesday morning in a remote part of northern Kenya, according to local police and the state department.
Among the dead were an executive with Telemundo, the US-based Spanish-language network owned by NBC Universal, and the director of Ecuador’s national intelligence service.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ケニアのサファリヘリ墜落事故で7人死亡、アメリカ人5人含む
articles.summary: ケニア北部の遠隔地でサファリヘリが墜落し、アメリカ人5人を含む7人全員が死亡。犠牲者には米国のテレビ局幹部やエクアドル情報機関の長官が含まれる。

articles.title: Spain to allow 500 children in Ceuta to go to mainland in immigration U-turn
articles.description:
Madrid government changes stance after previously saying anyone who entered territory illegally would be sent back
The Spanish government has U-turned and said it will allow 500 migrant children in Ceuta to relocate to the mainland.
The majority of the estimated 70,000 people who crossed into Ceuta – a Spanish territory on the coast of north Africa – on 30 July have returned to Morocco. However, under Spanish law, the state has a duty of care to young, unaccompanied migrants until they reach the age of 18.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: スペイン、セウタの子供500人を本土へ移送へ 移民政策を転換
articles.summary: スペイン政府は、スペイン領セウタにいる移民の子供500人を本土に移送することを許可し、移民政策を転換。以前は不法入国者の送還を主張していた。

articles.title: ‘No more!!!’: Trump lashes out after US-Canada talks devolve into trade war
articles.description:
PM Mark Carney says ‘we got attacked’ as tariffs come into force on items from hockey sticks to tongue depressors

The lesson from Canada’s collapsed trade talks with the US: negotiation may be futile

Donald Trump has hit back at Canada after a breakdown in negotiations plunged the two countries into a trade war.
In his first public comments since negotiations collapsed on Friday in Washington, the US president wrote on social media: “Canada wants the benefits of being a State, without being one!!!”
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 「もうたくさんだ！」：米・カナダ通商協議が決裂、貿易戦争に発展しトランプが激しく非難
articles.summary: 米国とカナダの通商協議が決裂し貿易戦争に発展したことを受け、トランプ大統領がカナダを激しく非難。「州の恩恵を受けながら、州ではない」と投稿した。

articles.title: The lesson from Canada’s collapsed trade talks with the US: negotiation may be futile
articles.description:
Breakdown shows Washington now prioritises its own interests over any semblance of shared economic ground

‘No more!!!’: Trump lashes out after US-Canada talks devolve into trade war

The calamitous collapse of trade negotiations between Canada and the United States is a warning to nations worldwide that pursuing any kind of dialogue with the current US administration is doomed at the outset, according to observers who say this recent episode indicates seeking a fair deal is futile.
Andrea Lawlor, an associate professor of political science at McMaster University in Ontario, said: “No matter the closeness of the historical relationship, the American administration has signalled that it now prioritises its interests above those of some sort of global economic coordination or harmony.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 米国との通商協議が決裂したカナダからの教訓：交渉は無意味かもしれない
articles.summary: カナダと米国の通商交渉の破綻は、米国政権との対話が無益である可能性を示唆。米国が現段階で自国利益を最優先していると専門家は指摘。

articles.title: Canada vows ‘dollar for dollar’ response as US puts 50% tariffs on some goods
articles.description:
Collapse of trade talks could lead to job losses, but biggest impact on traditional allies is expected to be political 
The US has imposed 50% tariffs on some goods from Canada, and Mark Carney, the country’s prime minister, has vowed to match them “dollar for dollar” after the collapse of trade talks.
The tariffs came into force on roughly $20bn (£14.6bn) of goods – ranging from hockey sticks to tongue depressors – at 04.00GMT. Trade experts said the tariffs could result in some job losses, but the largest impact is expected to be political, driving a further wedge between the traditional allies.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 米国が一部製品に50%の関税を課す中、カナダは「同額報復」を宣言
articles.summary: 米国がカナダからの特定品目に50%の関税を課したことを受け、カナダの首相は「同額報復」を宣言。貿易戦争激化により、失業や政治的亀裂が懸念される。

articles.title: JD Vance reportedly mocks Carney for trying to ‘out-tough’ Trump on trade
articles.description:
Audio recording of US vice-president apparently made at New York fundraiser and shared with Canadian Press
Leaked audio from a private event has reportedly captured the US vice-president, JD Vance, mocking Canada for apparently capitulating in a trade deal and taunting the prime minister, Mark Carney, for trying to “out-tough” Donald Trump.
The recording, which was reportedly made at a fundraiser and shared with the Canadian Press, comes in the last stretch of a difficult negotiation in which the US president has threatened to impose 50% tariffs on Canada.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: JDヴァンス副大統領がカーニー首相を嘲笑したと報じられる：貿易でトランプに「タフに挑む」
articles.summary: 米副大統領JDヴァンス氏が、非公開イベントでカナダのカーニー首相が貿易でトランプ大統領に「タフに挑もうとした」ことを嘲笑する音声が流出した。

articles.title: Strangers in their own land: Mexicans deported from Trump’s America find refuge in ‘Little LA’
articles.description:
With plentiful jobs and community support, one Mexico City neighbourhood has become a haven for those who have lived much of their lives in the US
With its wide avenues lined with tall palm trees, its quaint cafes and old-school cantinas, as well as the mix of English and Spanish spoken on the street, the Tabacalera neighborhood in downtown Mexico City has a certain US feel – so much so that it is has become known as Little LA.
The nickname is about more than appearances, however. In recent years, this corner of the metropolis has become a haven for many Mexicans deported from the US, particularly those who spent years or decades living across the border and for whom Mexico feels like a foreign country. In Little LA, they have found a more familiar place to belong.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 自分の土地でよそ者：トランプ政権下の米国から強制送還されたメキシコ人が「リトルLA」で安息の地を見つける
articles.summary: 米国から強制送還された多くのメキシコ人が、メキシコシティのタバカレラ地区（通称「リトルLA」）で新たな生活の場を見出している。この地域は、彼らに仕事とコミュニティ支援を提供。

articles.title: Iranian state TV broadcasts video targeting Barron Trump with $10m bounty
articles.description: Tehran state-run media has broadcast footage purportedly tracking US President Donald Trump's youngest son, showing the location of his university, escort vehicles and Secret Service posts, and alleging his movements were "fully monitored".
articles.titleJa: イラン国営テレビがバロン・トランプ氏を狙った1000万ドルの懸賞金映像を放送
articles.summary: イラン国営テレビが、トランプ米大統領の末息子バロン氏を追跡する映像を放送。大学や警護車両を映し、「行動は完全に監視されている」と主張。米国の要人を狙った挑発行為として注目される。

articles.title: South Korea says US cancelled joint marine drills over force constraints from Iran war
articles.description: The cancellation follows US President Donald Trump's order last week to scale down the separate annual Ulchi Freedom Shield exercises, cutting the joint drills from 11 days to five.
articles.titleJa: 韓国、イラン戦争の兵力制約により米が共同海兵隊演習を中止と発表
articles.summary: 韓国が、米国がイラン戦争による兵力制約のため共同海兵隊演習を中止したと発表。トランプ米大統領が別途のウルチ・フリーダム・シールド演習も縮小指示したことに続く動きで、地域の安全保障に影響。

articles.title: Latest news bulletin | August 24th, 2026 – Midday
articles.description: Catch up with the most important stories from around Europe and beyond this August 24th, 2026 - latest news, breaking news, World, Business, Entertainment, Politics, Culture, Travel.
articles.titleJa: 最新ニュース速報 | 2026年8月24日 – 正午
articles.summary: 2026年8月24日正午の、ヨーロッパ内外からの重要ニュース、速報、世界、ビジネス、エンターテイメント、政治、文化、旅行など、多岐にわたる最新情報。

articles.title: New Zealand's government introduces legislation to ban social media for under-16s
articles.description: Under the proposed law, firms like Meta could be fined up to 10% of their global revenue if they fail to comply.
articles.titleJa: ニュージーランド政府、16歳未満のソーシャルメディア利用禁止法案を提出
articles.summary: ニュージーランド政府が16歳未満のソーシャルメディア利用を禁止する法案を導入。違反企業には全世界収益の最大10%の罰金が科される可能性があり、テック企業に大きな影響。

articles.title: Hungarian air force Gripen fighter jet crashes near Szolnok
articles.description: The pilot managed to eject, and no one was injured. The circumstances of the accident are being investigated and the defence minister travelled to the site.
articles.titleJa: ハンガリー空軍のグリペン戦闘機がソルノク近郊で墜落
articles.summary: ハンガリー空軍のグリペン戦闘機がソルノク近郊で墜落。パイロットは脱出し無事。事故状況を調査中で、国防大臣が現場を訪れた。

articles.title: US threatens Iran with 'economic D-Day' as markets await sanctions announcement
articles.description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has announced the launch of what he calls an 'economic D-Day' against Iran, describing the campaign as the single greatest financial offensive ever directed at an adversary, with further details due later on Monday.
articles.titleJa: 米国、イランに「経済的D-デイ」を警告、市場は制裁発表を待つ
articles.summary: 米国財務長官がイランに対し「経済的D-デイ」を発動すると発表。これは敵対国に対する史上最大の金融攻勢とされ、市場は制裁の詳細発表を待つ。米イラン間の緊張がさらに高まる。

articles.title: Erling Haaland's new haircut goes viral and sends both fans and celebrities into a frenzy
articles.description: The Manchester City superstar has debuted a new look for the start of the Premier League season, and fans are divided. Zlatan Ibrahimovic told Haaland: “What did you do? You lost a bet or what? Block me and erase my number.”
articles.titleJa: アーリング・ハーランドの新ヘアスタイルが拡散、ファンやセレブを熱狂させる
articles.summary: マンチェスター・シティのスーパースター、アーリング・ハーランドがプレミアリーグ開幕に向けて新しいヘアスタイルを披露。その髪型がソーシャルメディアで拡散し、ファンやセレブの間で大きな話題となっている。

articles.title: Netherlands withdraws from 2027 Eurovision Song Contest, says competition 'no longer' neutral
articles.description: The 2026 competition was watched by 131 million viewers, down 35 million on the year before after five countries boycotted it over Israel's participation.

articles.description: Proud of his Welsh roots, Chile-based Argentine defender Jeremias James hopes for a rule change to help his international ambitions.
articles.titleJa: ウェールズ代表でのプレーを望むアルゼンチン人選手
articles.summary: ウェールズのルーツを持つチリ在住のアルゼンチン人DFヘレミアス・ジェームスが、代表選出規則の変更を希望している。

articles.title: Livestreamer's murder raises questions over relations between Mexico's creators and cartels
articles.description: The murder of content creator César Gastélum on Tuesday raises questions about why influencers are coming under attack.
articles.titleJa: メキシコでライブ配信者の殺害、クリエイターとカルテルの関係に疑問

articles.title: 'My grandmother subjected my baby to female genital mutilation behind my back'
articles.description: In Colombia, where FGM is still practised by some members of an indigenous group, a landmark bill banning the practice has been enacted.
articles.titleJa: 「祖母が私の知らない間に赤ちゃんに女性器切除を施した」
articles.summary: コロンビアでは一部の先住民グループで女性器切除が依然として行われており、この慣行を禁止する画期的な法案が制定された。

articles.title: How Mexican drug cartels have outsourced meth labs to Nigeria
articles.description: West Africa is becoming increasingly attractive to those who want to make and export illicit drugs.
articles.titleJa: メキシコの麻薬カルテル、覚せい剤ラボをナイジェリアに外注
articles.summary: メキシコの麻薬カルテルが覚せい剤製造ラボをナイジェリアに外注している。西アフリカは違法薬物製造・輸出にとって魅力的な地域になっている。

articles.title: Rumours swirled after a Vietnamese teen was run over - then came a stunning admission
articles.description: Confirmation of the circumstances around Do Ngoc Phuong Thuy's death have only spurred more questions.
articles.titleJa: ベトナムの10代の若者がひき逃げされた後、噂が飛び交い、その後驚くべき告白があった
articles.summary: ベトナム人少女ドー・ゴック・フオン・トゥイさんの死を巡る状況が確認された後も、更なる疑問が提起され、様々な憶測が飛び交っています。

articles.title: Hong Kong's Tiananmen activists convicted in national security trial
articles.description: Three activists were accused of inciting others to subvert state power under the China-introduced law.
articles.titleJa: 香港の天安門活動家、国家安全法裁判で有罪判決
articles.summary: 香港の活動家3名が中国導入の国家安全法に基づき、国家政権転覆扇動の罪で有罪判決を受けました。これは香港の政治的自由に対する大きな影響を示しています。

articles.title: Nanda Malini, one of Sri Lanka's best known voices of protest, dies at 82
articles.description: Once banned from national airwaves, Nanda Malini was known for her songs about social justice.
articles.titleJa: スリランカの著名な抗議の声、ナンダ・マリニ氏が82歳で死去
articles.summary: スリランカで社会正義を訴える歌で知られ、かつて国営放送で禁止された歌手ナンダ・マリニ氏が82歳で亡くなりました。

articles.title: The hotel booking mix-up that could free mushroom murderer
articles.description: A table tennis tournament and a throat lozenge could help Erin Patterson's lawyers overturn her convictions.
articles.titleJa: マッシュルーム殺人犯を釈放する可能性のあるホテル予約の混同
articles.summary: エリン・パターソン氏の弁護士は、卓球大会と喉のトローチが彼女の有罪判決を覆すのに役立つ可能性があると主張しています。

articles.title: Broken toilets, leaking roofs: Why India's 'cockroach' party wants to fix schools
articles.description: The poor state of government schools is the focus of a new campaign by India's Cockroach Janta Party (CJP).
articles.titleJa: 壊れたトイレ、雨漏りの屋根：インドの「ゴキブリ党」が学校を修繕したい理由
articles.summary: インドの「ゴキブリ・ジャンタ党」（CJP）は、政府系学校の劣悪な状況に焦点を当て、その改善を求める新たなキャンペーンを展開しています。

articles.title: Trump wants to be friends with Kim - but South Korea could pay the price
articles.description: US military exercises with South Korea end early on Friday, at a time when the North is in a position of strength.
articles.titleJa: トランプ氏、金氏との友好を望むが、韓国がその代償を払う可能性
articles.summary: 米韓合同軍事演習が早期終了する中、トランプ氏が金正恩氏との関係改善を望むことで、北朝鮮が優位な立場となり、韓国がその影響を受ける可能性が指摘されています。

articles.title: Why Indian law students don't want top judge at their graduation ceremony
articles.description: Students from two premier law universities say they don't want Chief Justice Surya Kant to attend their convocations.
articles.titleJa: インドの法学生が卒業式に最高裁判事を望まない理由
articles.summary: インドの主要な法科大学の学生たちが、スリヤ・カント最高裁判事が卒業式に出席することに反対しており、その理由が議論を呼んでいます。

articles.title: India built the world's biggest digital payments miracle. Now comes the bill
articles.description: India's UPI may finally face merchant fees, raising questions over who pays and whether users will resist.
articles.titleJa: インドは世界最大のデジタル決済の奇跡を築き上げた。今、その代償が訪れる
articles.summary: インドの統一決済インターフェース（UPI）がついに手数料導入に直面し、誰が支払うのか、そして利用者が抵抗するかどうかという疑問が提起されています。

articles.title: Deadline to register for 2026 Public Forum is 21 August
articles.description: The deadline for online registration for this year’s in-person Public Forum, which will take place on 15, 16 and 17 September, is 21 August 2026 (23.59 CET). Late and onsite registrations will not be accepted.
articles.titleJa: 2026年公開フォーラムの登録締め切りは8月21日
articles.summary: 2026年9月15～17日に開催される公開フォーラムのオンライン登録締め切りは、同年8月21日（CET午後11時59分）です。

articles.title: United Kingdom launches safeguard investigation on polyethylene terephthalate
articles.description: On 5 August 2026, the United Kingdom notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated, on the same day, a safeguard investigation on imports of certain polyethylene terephthalate (PET).
articles.titleJa: 英国、ポリエチレンテレフタレートに関するセーフガード調査を開始
articles.summary: 英国は2026年8月5日、特定のポリエチレンテレフタレート（PET）輸入に対し、セーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通知しました。

articles.title: World Trade and Tech Day to explore policies to make AI work for inclusive trade
articles.description: The WTO will host the first World Trade and Tech Day on 14 September at its headquarters in Geneva, bringing together trade and information and communications technology (ICT) policymakers, industry leaders and other stakeholders to discuss how artificial intelligence (AI) strategies can better support economies' efforts to maximize the gains of international trade.
articles.titleJa: 世界貿易と技術の日、AIを包括的貿易に活用する政策を探る
articles.summary: WTOがジュネーブで「世界貿易と技術の日」を開催。AI戦略が国際貿易の利益最大化にどう貢献するか、政策立案者らが議論する。

articles.title: Global goods trade resilient in the first quarter of 2026 despite war in Middle East
articles.description: World merchandise trade growth exceeded expectations in the first quarter of 2026 as surging trade in electronic components related to artificial intelligence (AI) offset the negative impact of the conflict in the Middle East, which began in the final month of the quarter. Trade disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz are expected to be more fully captured in trade data for the next quarter.
articles.titleJa: 中東戦争にもかかわらず2026年第1四半期のグローバル物品貿易は堅調
articles.summary: 2026年第1四半期、AI関連電子部品貿易の急増が中東紛争の悪影響を相殺し、世界物品貿易は予想を上回る堅調さを示した。

articles.title: Brazil initiates dispute regarding additional duties imposed by the United States
articles.description: Brazil has requested WTO dispute consultations with the United States regarding additional US duties on products originating in Brazil as a result of two investigations by the United States under Section 301 of the US Trade Act of 1974. Brazil said the additional duties are above the duties otherwise applicable under the US harmonized tariff schedule. The request was circulated to WTO members on 30 July.
articles.titleJa: ブラジル、米国による追加関税について紛争解決手続きを開始
articles.summary: ブラジルは米国に対し、米国のブラジル製品に対する追加関税についてWTO紛争解決協議を要請。関税が規定を超えていると主張。

articles.title: WTO panel issues report regarding Turkish measures on EVs and other types of vehicles
articles.description: On 28 July, the WTO circulated the panel report in the case brought by China in "Türkiye — Measures Concerning Electric Vehicles and Other Types of Vehicles from China" (DS629).
articles.titleJa: WTOパネル、トルコによるEVなどの車両に関する措置について報告書を発行
articles.summary: WTOは中国が提起した、トルコによる電気自動車など中国製車両への措置に関するパネル報告書を回覧した。

articles.title: Lithuania gives EUR 30,000 to help developing economies and LDCs improve trade skillset
articles.description: Lithuania is contributing EUR 30,000 (approximately CHF 28,000) in 2026 to finance training programmes for government officials from developing economies, including least-developed countries (LDCs). This contribution to the WTO Global Trust Fund will support these economies in deepening their expertise on WTO issues and help them participate more effectively in the rules-based multilateral trading system.
articles.titleJa: リトアニア、途上国および後発開発途上国の貿易スキル向上支援に3万ユーロを拠出
articles.summary: リトアニアは2026年に3万ユーロを拠出し、途上国の政府職員向け貿易研修プログラムを支援。WTO関連知識の深化を促す。

articles.title: Uzbekistan reaffirms 2026 WTO accession goal, thanks members for continuing engagement
articles.description: Uzbekistan reaffirmed its determination to complete its WTO accession process within 2026 at a meeting of the Working Party on the Accession of Uzbekistan on 27 and 28 July, soon after its last meeting in March. The head of Uzbekistan's delegation, Chief Negotiator Azizbek Urunov, stressed that maintaining a strong pace of engagement and addressing members' remaining concerns will be critical to bringing the accession process to a successful conclusion.
articles.titleJa: ウズベキスタン、2026年までのWTO加盟目標を再確認し、継続的な関与に感謝
articles.summary: ウズベキスタンは7月の作業部会で、2026年までのWTO加盟完了目標を再確認し、継続的な関与と懸念事項への対応の重要性を強調した。

articles.title: Russia requests dispute panel on EU carbon border adjustment and emissions trading scheme
articles.description: At a meeting of the Dispute Settlement Body (DSB) on 24 July, members considered a request from the Russian Federation for the establishment of a dispute panel to review the European Union's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) Package and alleged export subsidy under the EU scheme for trading greenhouse gas emission allowances. The DSB Chair, Ambassador Guilherme de Aguiar Patriota (Brazil), also updated members on dispute settlement reform consultations and convened an informal discussion after the meeting to further hear members' views.
articles.titleJa: ロシア、EUの炭素国境調整メカニズムおよび排出量取引制度に関する紛争解決パネルを要請
articles.summary: ロシアはEUの炭素国境調整メカニズムと排出量取引制度における輸出補助金について、WTO紛争解決パネルの設置を要請。

articles.title: Why is transit in goods free but trade is not?
articles.description: In my previous two posts on the value of the WTO, I argued that when governments set trade policies independently, they focus on domestic effects but often overlook the costs imposed on trading partners. International trade agreements help governments take account of these cross-border spillovers (terms-of-trade externalities) by encouraging reciprocal negotiations over trade policy. While these negotiations will reduce trade protection, they will not necessarily lead to free trade. But if governments do not generally commit themselves to free trade, why has freedom of transit for goods been seen differently?
articles.titleJa: なぜ物品の通過は自由なのに貿易はそうではないのか？
articles.summary: 政府は貿易政策で国内効果を優先しがちで、国際貿易協定は保護主義を減らすが、自由貿易には至らない。物品の通過と貿易の自由度の違いを問う。
